title: Kirsten Theuns:
headline: Adults were not born with AI. Young people were. So adults must listen to them.
story: Kirsten Theuns of Aflatoun, a global partner of NFTE, talks with Stephanie Alvarado at the NFTE office. Her point is simple: we were not born with AI, young people are.
So adults who plan for young people must first listen to them. It must feel open and hopeful, never afraid of AI.
